upstream.scope: Generic server-hinted keep-in-view for collection items (§4 inv. 13, §6.3, §7.4, §8, §12.1, §22.5, §22.7, §26, §32): one standard registry property, Rust and Swift store rules, authoritative settlement alongside promoted selection, SDK set/clear, and a generic AppKit reveal path that never touches selection; no Process Explorer feature work and no application-specific client path

entries.feature: Standard registry property `keep_visible` (namespace 0, value type `value`, control_specific) added through protocol/registry.yaml and srui.proto with codegen: build.rs asserts the new property count, srui.pb.swift and RegistryTables.swift regenerated with no residual diff, spec/registries.md and CLAUDE.md updated; the fallback (a client without support keeps its viewport where the user put it) is documented
entries.scope: PX-017-G01/protocol registry.yaml, srui.proto, generate_proto.sh outputs; server-rust/semantic-tree/build.rs; spec/registries.md; CLAUDE.md

entries.feature: Both stores admit keep_visible only as an ItemId on a List, Table or Tree that has a model_ref, evaluated on the resulting property set of CREATE_NODE, SET_PROPERTY, CLEAR_PROPERTY and BATCH_PROPERTY_SET (clearing model_ref while it is held is refused); refusals use invalid_keep_visible and roll back the whole transaction; independent of value and selection_mode; suite 1 positive and negative vectors replay identically in Rust and Swift and the manifest count is exact
entries.scope: PX-017-G01/semantic-tree store/mod.rs validate_keep_visible, store/error.rs, store/node.rs; client-macos SemanticModel/SemanticStore.swift; protocol/conformance-vectors suite 1 keep_visible vectors and manifest.json

entries.feature: Authoritative settlement mirrors PX-011-G01: an assignment naming an item the model does not hold is refused with ItemNotFound; delete, range reset, positional update and model_ref change clear the hint in the same commit; a pre-built sessiond commit_transaction that would leave it dangling is refused; runs on SDK transaction/transaction_custom, sessiond transaction_with_result and range fulfilment; settling a hint never touches value and vice versa

SDK set and clear: UiTransaction::{set_keep_visible, clear_keep_visible, keep_visible} and List/Table/Tree::{set_keep_visible, clear_keep_visible, keep_visible}; set records the authoritative item as a one-item MODEL_RESET_RANGE before SET_PROPERTY(keep_visible)

Generic AppKit reveal-without-selection for Table, List and Tree: a commit that sets the hint or changes the item's row index scrolls the minimum to show it; an unchanged row never scrolls; an uncached item waits and is revealed on arrival with nothing requested; clearing never scrolls; it never selects, deselects, posts a selection notification, emits SELECTION_CHANGED or touches promotion memory; 20 rapid keyboard selections while the item moves end on the last selection
